question: Can the real Film Studio product connect the accepted PB.3 typed B01 workspace to an approved, bounded render job that emits an EEVEE preview, a Cycles multilayer EXR and independently auditable process, pixel, pass, cost and failure receipts?

standingAuthority.reason: The work is local, bounded, reversible product development plus ordinary validated fast-forward publication in the two existing repositories.

f05.reuse: Profiles and audit semantics only; PB.4 must run through new product-owned code on the PB.3 workspace and cannot claim the historical pixels as PB.4 output.

productIncrement.goal: A visible Render Job panel and product-owned bounded render contract, not an external-only research script.
requiredCapabilities: Typed render-manifest inspection with self-hash, approval, exact source, stage, output-root and profile validation before rendering.
Film workspace fields expose job id, manifest, bounded evidence root, status and last receipt hash.
A visible product operator inspects an approved render job without rendering and exposes explicit Preview and Final stage status.
Product-owned stage execution accepts only PREVIEW or FINAL and writes self-hashed stage/failure receipts inside the authorized evidence root.
No proposal-originated Python, shell, network path, arbitrary output path or source .blend save authority.

negativeControls: A manifest whose self hash or approval is altered must write a bounded failure receipt and reject before a render call.
An output path escaping the exact evidence root must write a bounded failure receipt and reject before a render call.
A FINAL request without an exact verified PREVIEW receipt must reject before a render call.
acceptance: The three-path product patch builds cleanly from full-history film-engine baseline and preserves independent identity and PB.1/PB.3 source invariants.
The visible product panel inspects the exact approved job and persists typed render-job status without rendering.
The product renders exactly one frozen EEVEE preview and one Cycles multilayer EXR from the accepted PB.3 B01 workspace with zero mouse, model and network calls.
All process, pixel, pass, cost and failure receipts are self-hashed, mutually bound and independently audited.
All three negative controls reject before a render call and write no escaped artifact.
The source .blend and official Blender configuration remain unchanged; work/evidence remain within ceilings.
stopRules: Do not mutate the retained PB.1 source/build or any PB.3 work/evidence root.
Any source change outside the three allowed paths, any C/C++ change, or a patch over the line ceiling stops PB.4 before build.
Any baseline, manifest, source scene, build, OCIO, free-space or output-root mismatch stops before rendering.
Any positive render or independent audit failure retains attempt-01 and forbids same-root repair.
Do not weaken render profiles, pixel/pass thresholds, negative controls or resource ceilings after observing output.
Do not begin PB.5, create a release, distribute a binary, sign, notarize, force-push or incur a new charge.
claimCeiling: A PASS can prove one product-owned B01 preview/final render job and its receipts on this host. It cannot prove restart-safe PB.5 control, B62 quality, arbitrary scenes, GPU/cross-host pixels, production readiness or public distribution.
